decisions.reason: As a consumer superfood mix it sits furthest from the firm's core industrial waste-to-energy and engineering focus, so management would likely reallocate resources to higher-fit technology ventures.
The modular waste-to-energy extensions fit the established plant business and can support project-based sales even if they were marketed less prominently than the flagship lines.
The waste-oil-to-energy plant was explicitly treated as a flagship and matches the firm's core strategy of decentralized, practical waste-conversion technologies.
Plastic-waste-to-fuel is close to the firm's established offer and was highlighted as a strategic direction, so management would usually keep it despite commercialization risk.
